step1_figure.circuit_type: Three-input CMOS NAND gate driving a capacitive load
step1_figure.description: Figure 12.2 shows the schematic of an n-input static CMOS NAND gate with parallel PMOS pull-up devices and series NMOS pull-down devices. The provided netlist implements N=3 with all inputs tied together to Vin, driving a 50 fF load capacitance C1 as analyzed in Example 12.3 and Figure 12.10 (page 361).

switching_point_voltage.description: Switching point voltage (Vsp) where Vin = Vout when all inputs are tied together

equation.formula: V_SP = (sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)) * V_THN + (VDD - V_THP)) / (1 + sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)))
equation.explanation: Calculates the DC switching threshold of an n-input NAND gate where all N inputs switch simultaneously. The series NMOS effective transconductance scales by 1/N while the parallel PMOS devices conduct in parallel scaling effective transconductance by N.
equation.assumptions: All inputs tied together; transistors operate in saturation at switching threshold; channel length modulation neglected.

sky130_expected.calculation: With N=3, equal transistor sizing (W/L ratio identical for NMOS and PMOS): beta_n/beta_p = (un*Cox)/(up*Cox) = 270u / 50u = 5.4. Then transconductance ratio sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)) = sqrt(5.4 / 9) = sqrt(0.6) = 0.7746. Using VDD = 1.8 V, V_THN = 0.42 V, V_THP = 0.42 V: V_SP = [0.7746 * 0.42 + (1.8 - 0.42)] / (1 + 0.7746) = (0.3253 + 1.38) / 1.7746 = 1.7053 / 1.7746 = 0.961 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In Sky130 with equal W/L devices, the 3 series NMOS balance the 3 parallel PMOS, centering Vsp very close to ideal VDD/2 (0.9 V).

transconductance_ratio.description: Effective transconductance ratio between NMOS network and PMOS network for N-input NAND

equation.formula: ratio = sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)) = (1 / N) * sqrt(beta_n / beta_p)
equation.explanation: Ratio of the effective pull-down transconductance to the pull-up transconductance when all inputs are tied together.
equation.assumptions: N identical NMOS in series and N identical PMOS in parallel.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined directly by mobility ratio (un/up = 5.4) and series/parallel scaling factor 1/N = 1/3.

high_to_low_delay.description: High-to-low propagation delay (tPHL) driving load capacitance Cload

equation.formula: t_PHL ≈ 0.7 * N * R_n * C_load + 0.35 * R_n * C_oxn * N^2
equation.explanation: Delay when all inputs transition high, discharging Cload through N NMOS devices in series.
equation.assumptions: Step input on Vin; load capacitance Cload (50 fF) dominates output node capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: For W=1u, L=0.15u: ID_sat_n ≈ 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * (1/0.15) * (1.8 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 1.71 mA; Rn ≈ VDD / (2 * ID_sat_n) ≈ 1.8 / 3.42 mA ≈ 526 ohm. For N=3 series NMOS and Cload = 50 fF: t_PHL ≈ 0.7 * 3 * 526 * 50e-15 ≈ 55 ps. Accounting for channel resistance and internal node charge sharing, expected t_PHL is approximately 60 ps to 120 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominant delay term comes from 3 series NMOS discharging the 50 fF load capacitance.

low_to_high_delay.description: Low-to-high propagation delay (tPLH) with all PMOS switching in parallel

equation.explanation: Delay when all inputs transition low, charging Cload through N parallel PMOS devices.
equation.assumptions: All N inputs switch simultaneously; Cload (50 fF) dominates node capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: For W=1u, L=0.15u: ID_sat_p ≈ 0.5 * 50uA/V^2 * (1/0.15) * (1.8 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 0.317 mA; Rp ≈ 1.8 / (2 * 0.317 mA) ≈ 2.84 k_ohm. With N=3 PMOS in parallel: Rp_eff = 2840 / 3 ≈ 947 ohm. t_PLH ≈ 0.7 * 947 * 50e-15 ≈ 33 ps. Accounting for parasitics, typical t_PLH is around 40 ps to 70 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Parallel PMOS pull-up configuration reduces effective resistance by a factor of 3.

output_high_voltage.description: Static output high voltage when input is at logic low (0 V)

equation.explanation: With Vin = 0 V, all PMOS pull-up transistors are fully turned on and NMOS pull-down transistors are off, pulling Vout to VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Full rail-to-rail swing in static CMOS.

output_low_voltage.description: Static output low voltage when input is at logic high (VDD)

equation.explanation: With Vin = VDD, NMOS transistors are fully on and PMOS transistors are off, pulling Vout down to ground.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Static CMOS pulls completely to 0 V under purely capacitive load.

fall_time.description: Output fall time (90% to 10% of VDD)

equation.explanation: Transition time for the output to discharge from 1.62 V (90%) to 0.18 V (10%).

sky130_expected.reasoning: RC discharge of 50 fF through 3 series NMOS channels.

rise_time.description: Output rise time (10% to 90% of VDD)

equation.explanation: Transition time for the output to charge from 0.18 V (10%) to 1.62 V (90%).

sky130_expected.reasoning: RC charging of 50 fF through 3 parallel PMOS channels.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for 3-input CMOS NAND gate measuring DC switching point (Vsp), VOH, VOL, propagation delays (tPHL, tPLH), and rise/fall times with 50 fF capacitive load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 3-Input CMOS NAND Gate Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Sizing parameters
.param W_xm1=1u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=1u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=1u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=1u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1u L_xm6=0.15u

* Power Supply
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Circuit under test
xm4 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm1 P001 Vin 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 P002 Vin P001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 Vout Vin P002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
C1 Vout 0 5e-14

* Input Source: Pulse for Transient, Swept for DC
Vin Vin 0 pulse(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 1n 2.5n)

.control
* === DC Analysis: VTC and Switching Point ===
dc Vin 0 1.8 0.002
let diff = v(Vout) - v(Vin)
meas dc switching_point_voltage when diff=0
meas dc output_high_voltage find v(Vout) at=0
meas dc output_low_voltage find v(Vout) at=1.8

* === Transient Analysis: Propagation Delays and Edge Times ===
tran 5p 3n
meas tran high_to_low_delay trig v(Vin) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran low_to_high_delay trig v(Vin) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran fall_time trig v(Vout) val=1.62 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.18 fall=1
meas tran rise_time trig v(Vout) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=1.62 rise=1

print switching_point_voltage output_high_voltage output_low_voltage
print high_to_low_delay low_to_high_delay fall_time rise_time
quit
.endc
.end
